        err = abs(out['mean'] - ct)
        errs.append(err)

            p_hot.append(err)
        # 90% interval score: (upper - lower) + (2/0.1)*(lower - y)*I(y < lower) + (2/0.1)*(y - upper)*I(y > upper)

        interval_scores.append(iscore)
        coverages.append(1.0 if l <= ct <= u else 0.0)
    person_maes[pid] = np.mean(errs)
    if p_hot:
        hot_person_errors[pid] = np.mean(p_hot)
